enforcementNote: Every rule id below has exactly one implementation in schema/semantic_validate.py (RULE_IMPLS). The validator reads `severity` and `exceptions` from THIS file at runtime and refuses to run if the id sets differ. Each rule was checked against templates/templates.json node lists when written (`checkedAgainstTemplates`); the adversarial suite synthesizes one control per template.

rules.statement: nodes[] must match the declared template's node list in order, keyed on (section, variant), honouring required/repeatable (article-chapter and text-page-chapter repeat; blog-featured-banner and blog-post-grid are optional on blog-category).
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: all 8 templates (home, pricing, not-found, blog-index, blog-category, blog-article, text-page, legal)

rules.statement: A section with constraints.onePerPage (every section except the repeatable article-chapter and text-page-chapter) may appear at most once per page.
announcement-bar, when present, is node 0.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: index 0 in home, pricing, not-found, blog-index, text-page, legal; absent on blog-category and blog-article

rules.statement: site-header immediately follows announcement-bar when the page has one, otherwise it is node 0.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: index 1 on home, pricing, not-found, blog-index, text-page, legal; index 0 on blog-category and blog-article (no announcement bar, measured)

rules.statement: site-footer is the last node.
site-header variant is 'hero-overlay' if and only if the next node is hero-home (the header renders inside the home Hero wrapper, Hero.jsx:94-95); otherwise 'standalone'.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: home: hero-overlay (next is hero-home); standalone on the other 7 templates

rules.statement: Exactly one hero-category section per page (hero-home | pricing-hero | blog-index-hero | article-header | text-page-header), except on hero-less templates.

exceptions.reason: The 404 template has no hero; not-found-block takes the hero slot (NotFound.jsx).
Legal pages render only the empty policy-embed slot between header and footer (LegalPage.jsx); no hero exists.

rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: 1 hero on home, pricing, blog-index, blog-category, blog-article, text-page; 0 on not-found and legal (exceptions)

rules.statement: press-marquee, when present, immediately follows hero-home (it lives inside the Hero wrapper).
final-cta, when present, immediately precedes site-footer.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: home, pricing, blog-index, blog-category, blog-article: final-cta -> site-footer; not-found, text-page, legal have no final-cta

rules.statement: featurette-carousel and testimonials-carousel should not be adjacent (inferred rhythm guidance: on home they are separated by clinical-board and how-riley-works).
Two marquee sections should not be adjacent, except the observed press -> family pair on home.

exceptions.reason: Observed on the real homepage (Hero.jsx PressMarquee is the last child of Hero, followed by PersonalizationMarquee at HomePage.jsx:20).

rules.statement: At most 2 infinite marquee sections per page (home has exactly 2).
Every string with x-maxWords in the schema must not exceed it (whitespace word count).
In gradient-band.comparisonTable every row.marks length equals columns length.
Every node.motion carries the section's const reducedMotionFallback (belt-and-braces with the schema).

If page.route is a mapped route (templates.json routes: 249 incl. every article), page.template must equal its mapped template. Dead sitemap slugs and linked-but-unbuilt paths (author/reviewer pages, /support) bind to not-found only. Unknown new routes are allowed.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: every mapped route; dead slugs + unbuilt links -> not-found

rules.statement: For must-reuse-exact / must-not-fabricate roles the assetRef must be a registered file of the role; generated:/user-supplied:/placeholder: refs only for may-generate-new roles; /assets/ refs of generic roles must be registered files.
href appears only with assetRole placeholder-url, and placeholder-url always carries an href on a reserved .example/.invalid host (schema pattern).
blog-pagination page <= totalPages; blog-category always 'Page 1 of 1'; blog-category-tabs activeIndex points at a tab.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: blog-index (Page 1 of 37 at 218 listed posts), blog-category (1 of 1)

rules.statement: Article blocks carry exactly the payload their kind needs (list->items, promo->cta, image/downloadable-image->image) and nothing else.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: blog-article (placeholder body: p, promo, h2, h3, ul, image, editor-note, downloadable-image)

rules.statement: Every citation superscript number in an article block resolves to an entry of article-sources.
article-toc entries equal the article-chapter headings, in order (the TOC lists the body's H2s).
Sections with retrievalEligible:false (runtime UI: cookie-consent) never appear in nodes[]; overlays[] holds only pinned retrieval-ineligible sections.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: cookie-consent is mounted globally (App.jsx), on every template

rules.statement: Registry-level: section contracts' retrievalEligible matches the RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE pin in code (both validators), false needs a 30+ char reason, and any section whose id/title looks like runtime UI must be pinned.

Registry-level: every real-world-weighted role keeps its pinned generationPolicy (PINNED_POLICIES) and EVERY role keeps its pinned availability (PINNED_AVAILABILITY); non-generation-safe roles declare generation-safe substitutes; the role set equals the schema assetRole enums.

mode=generation requires page.brand and rejects the Riley brand, product and feature names, promo code and letter-spaced spellings in any copy (schema/leakage-patterns.json brand). page.brand is not allowed in mode=clone.
mode=generation rejects every non-generation-safe asset role and every Riley source file (/assets/...) ref; use generated:/user-supplied:/placeholder: refs of the role's generationSafeSubstitutes.

mode=generation rejects real people: clinicians, article authors and the medical reviewer, testimonial attributions, user-story names (leakage-patterns persons) and real-person-likeness asset roles (portraits, author avatars, user photos).
mode=generation rejects real press outlets and comparison competitors (leakage-patterns organizations) and third-party trademark roles (press logos, social marks).
mode=generation rejects Riley product UI: the Rive chat animations (role rive-animation) and their artboard/state-machine identifiers; use placeholder-screenshot.

mode=generation rejects any copy string sharing a 5-word shingle with Riley source copy (components, blog titles/excerpts, specs), compared as hashes after normalisation (NFKC, zero-width removal, homoglyphs, quotes, dashes).

mode=generation rejects Riley's health/development/pricing claims (source-derived) and generic unverifiable health claims (policy list: clinically proven, pediatrician-approved, prevents SIDS, ...). Health/development claims are must-not-fabricate for this consumer parenting category.
mode=generation rejects ratings and review counts (stars, N/5, N reviews, rated N, #1) and Riley's review headings: a generated page has no verified ratings.
mode=generation rejects app-store marks and links (App Store, 'Download on the', OneLink, store-badge / app-store-onelink roles); store badges must be operator-supplied official artwork.
mode=generation rejects Riley/source domains and any URL whose host is not a reserved .example/.invalid placeholder, plus live-endpoint roles and Riley article routes.
mode=generation rejects Riley's policy-embed ids and vendor (Termly) and the policy-embed role; legal text is operator-supplied.
node.style values must be canonical token paths present in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json.
node.style must not carry raw colour values (hex, rgb/rgba, hsl, oklch, color()); use a colour-role token.
node.style must not carry raw lengths (px, rem, em, %, vh/vw); use a section-spacing / radius token.
node.style.fontFamily must be one of the catalog font families (Cadiz cuts, Recoleta serif).

node.style token category must fit the property (surface/text/accent: color-roles; spacing: section-spacing; fontFamily: font-family; radius: radius) and colour roles must exist in page.theme; tokens of another theme are rejected.

semanticCategories.SHELL: site chrome (announcement, header, footer); excluded from the wrapper-share gate
semanticCategories.NAVIGATION: search, tabs, pagination, TOC, share rows
